title: default
role: loads the plugin-vendored working conventions, and the vendored guide-PR course when a PR is in play

title: sessions
role: attaches and clones the session-record store, named by SESSIONS_STORE_REPO, a sessionsStore declaration, or the built-in mehrlander/web-tools-private, so a task-spawned session is recorded like a hand-started one

title: load-skill
role: fetch a skill by URL where the plugin is absent, or from another source

title: web-tools-app
role: browse any repo and move files across repos with the Web Tools app

title: tree
role: render a linked file tree of the repo, table-first for mobile

title: in-flight
role: check whether a branch, PR, or task is already working on something, and reconcile stale tracker claims

title: tasks
role: operate the cross-session project tracker, and the filing rules: the bar, the propose-first gate, no fragmenting

title: repo-review
role: read the repo's own state and report what stands out, at three depths (light, deep, sweep); probes, layers, lenses and destinations declared per repo

title: sandbox-traps
role: the web sandbox's enumerable failures, each impersonating a worse one: the test that tells them apart, and the rule

title: content-registry
role: the epistemic content registry: classify a repo's artifacts and their corpus membership in a curated content.csv; scaffold, verify, extract

title: concept-index
role: build a repo's declared vocabulary and check a piece of writing against it: unlinked file names, terms of art used as if already known

title: drop-link
role: mint a link that opens GitHub's new-file form on the working branch, so long content lands on the branch without riding through chat

title: file-retrieval
role: retrieve files from a configured corpus through a fixed-behavior tool: ranked snippet search and whole-document reads, one auditable command

title: scour
role: acquisition fan-out: send agents to gather source material that does not exist locally, and map who says what about a subject across the open web

title: gold-set
role: measurement fan-out: build an independently labeled sample that scores a classifier or extractor for correctness, blind readers plus an adversarial skeptic plus a scoring script, and decide from the scorecard whether the program should change

title: apple-shortcuts-actions
role: compose Apple Shortcuts actions and hand them over as a tappable paste-in link for the device clipboard

title: tend
role: cultivate the workspace: investigate branches, pull requests, trackers and snags, store each conclusion as a finding, and bring the owner a prepared user call only where the next step needs their word

title: notes
role: leave, reply to and read notes: short, signed observations addressed to a repo, branch, file, pull request, task, snag, or another note

title: Surfacing
role: the canonical surfacing primitives; a byte-matched copy ships beside the plugin's default skill and is loaded with the writing rules

title: Qualified writing
role: the canonical prose rules; a byte-matched copy ships beside the plugin's default skill and is loaded with the surfacing primitives

title: Venues
role: the venue map: where work can run besides the session reading it, and the attended-versus-unattended split that decides where a job belongs

title: Project tracker
role: opt-in cross-session tracker: one file per task plus a generated board

title: Constellation architecture
role: the portable kernel of the what-goes-where doctrine: commit discipline, visibility forces repo boundaries, conventions pull from a public hub, the repo owns its own scope, documentation has four places. The theory behind the app's Map view

title: Web Tools app
role: the Web Tools app: mission, goals, boundary, addresses, and what every view shares

title: Artifacts
role: the bake-and-publish pipeline and the 📦 marker's place in the link-choice matrix

title: Headless vendoring
role: build with CDN stacks and test them headless where the sandbox blocks their CDNs

title: Markdown in chat
role: working visually with markdown in a chat client; tables over nested bullets

title: GitHub markdown
role: what GitHub's renderer does with Mermaid, math, alerts, sparklines

title: MCP server routing
role: unexpected approval prompts with two GitHub MCP servers are often routing artifacts

title: Web sandbox environment
role: dated facts about the Claude Code web sandbox: network, persistence, testing recipes

title: Content envelopes
role: the envelope family: the surface contract, chat-results, and the schemas that validate them

title: Plugin source
role: the portable plugin's source tree: every skill it carries and the hook bundle, also served as static files that load-skill fetches

title: build-board.py
role: regenerate a tracker's board.md from task frontmatter; ships inside the plugin

title: in-flight.py
role: classify a branch estate into live / merged / unrelated / undecidable and reconcile tracker claims against it; ships inside the plugin

title: Column primitives
role: what kind of thing a column holds: id, label, locator, value. The role axis, its crossing with the claim-versus-support position, and the dependency that a value domain is only askable under label or locator

title: Surfacing course
role: the canonical guide-PR lifecycle; a byte-matched copy ships beside the default skill for PR work, and the pr-subscribe-hint hook injects it after an MCP-created PR

title: Direct-to-main registry
role: the registry of approved direct-to-main processes and synchronization discipline
